Hi all — looping in on the contracting path. Thanks Jordan for the intro. A few process notes from Redwood legal to keep timelines tight: 

1) Initial contract review SLA: our team aims to provide an initial response with comments within 3 business days of receiving a tracked-change Word doc.
2) Rounds: we generally accommodate up to two rounds of redlines before escalation to execs; if the counterparty sends substantive new language after round two, we’ll need an extension to the timeline.
3) Required artifacts: please share your standard PO/billing contact and any required tax forms. We will upload SOC2 and the DPA to the drive link during the security review window.

Attached: Redwood_SLA_Template_2026.docx (our standard commercial table + timeline).

My direct contact: rishi.malhotra@redwoodinference.com — please send the tracked-change file to me and cc jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com and monica.patel@redwoodinference.com.

I’ll review any procurement questionnaire you send and aim to return comments on the DPA within the same 3-business-day window.

Regards,
Rishi Malhotra
Senior Counsel, Redwood Inference
